english: For a real number $t$, let $[t]$ denote the greatest integer less than or equal to $t$. Let $f:D\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=\sqrt{\dfrac{([x]+6)([x]-1)}{\log_{1/2}(|x|-3)}}$, where $D$ is the set of all real numbers $x$ for which this expression is a real number. Then the sum of all the integers in $D$ is ______.
hindi: किसी वास्तविक संख्या $t$ के लिए, $[t]$ उस महत्तम पूर्णांक को दर्शाता है जो $t$ से छोटा या उसके बराबर है। माना कि $f:D\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=\sqrt{\dfrac{([x]+6)([x]-1)}{\log_{1/2}(|x|-3)}}$ द्वारा परिभाषित है, जहाँ $D$ उन सभी वास्तविक संख्याओं $x$ का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए यह व्यंजक एक वास्तविक संख्या है। तब $D$ में स्थित सभी पूर्णांकों का योगफल ______ है।
solution: Let $N=([x]+6)([x]-1)$. Need $N\ge0$ where the log is positive and $N\le0$ where it is negative
solution_full:
The logarithm needs $|x|-3>0$, i.e. $|x|>3$. The fraction needs $\log_{1/2}(|x|-3)

e\pm4$.
Because the base $\dfrac12$ is less than $1$, $\log_{1/2}u>0$ for $0<u<1$ and $\log_{1/2}u<0$ for $u>1$. So the denominator is positive for $3<|x|<4$ and negative for $|x|>4$.
The square root needs the fraction to be $\ge0$. With $N=([x]+6)([x]-1)$, this means $N\ge0$ when $3<|x|<4$, and $N\le0$ when $|x|>4$.
Case $-4<x<-3$: $[x]=-4$, $N=2\cdot(-5)=-10<0$ while the denominator is positive, so this interval is excluded.
Case $|x|>4$: $N\le0$ means $-6\le[x]\le1$, i.e. $-6\le x<2$. Combined with $|x|>4$ this gives $-6\le x<-4$ (no $x>4$ satisfies $x<2$). At $x=-6$, $N=0$ and the fraction is $0$, which is allowed.
So $D=[-6,-4)\cup(3,4)$. The point $x=-4$ is excluded because there the logarithm is $\log_{1/2}1=0$.
The integers in $D$ are $-6$ and $-5$; their sum is $-11$.
originality_note: New: sign analysis of a GIF product over a log with base below 1 whose argument is |x| - 3, so the sign of the denominator flips at |x| = 4 and the GIF numerator is tested on each side (way 5). Closest known: domains of sqrt(log_{1/2}(...)) and of expressions with [x]. Different because: the two sign regions of the denominator require opposite signs of the GIF product, and x = -4 (an integer) is excluded only through the logarithm.

concept_use.Domain and range of functions involving: The numerator ([x] + 6)([x] - 1) is constant on each integer block; its sign condition becomes -6 <= [x] <= 1, i.e. -6 <= x < 2, and [x] = 3 or -4 on (3,4) and (-4,-3).
concept_use.Domain of algebraic, logarithmic, expone: The log needs |x| > 3, the denominator is non-zero only for |x| != 4, the base 1/2 reverses the sign at |x| = 4, and the square root needs a non-negative radicand.
